node_geometry.node_rule: all 33 physical rows of Sites.csv; response may not filter the node registry

response_semantics.positive_label: KIRA.csv cell token 1 at a frozen site and frozen sampling occasion
response_semantics.negative_label: KIRA.csv cell token 0; interpreted only as observed non-detection under the released acoustic sampling design, never biological absence
response_semantics.unavailable_action: exclude only that site-occasion from model/count risk sets; do not convert to zero
response_semantics.required_site_registry: exactly the 33 frozen Sites.csv IDs, each exactly once; duplicate, missing, or unexpected site is terminal
response_semantics.sampling_period_columns: exact literal columns 1 through 20 mapped bijectively to Samples.csv Sample Period

temporal_split.prediction_sequence_rule: sort Samples.csv by parsed Date ascending; break exact date ties by numeric Sample Period
temporal_split.fit_policy_temporal_boundary: initialize lag/source state from period 1; build sequential calibration features for periods 2-12; fit once after calibration; predict heldout occasions sequentially without refitting while updating only lag/Layer-A state after each heldout label is revealed

process_source.interpretation: within-season observed-detection persistence/spatial-source possibility hypotheses; not claims of dispersal or true occupancy
process_source.initialization: period 1 observed positive sites seed previous and historical observed-source sets but are not scored and do not eliminate worlds
process_source.immediate_previous_observed: sources are sites with positive labels in the immediately previous chronological sampling occasion
process_source.cumulative_observed_history: sources are the union of sites with at least one positive label in any earlier chronological sampling occasion
process_source.external_open_world: one conservative universal-source possibility supports every frozen site at every scored occasion because the 33-site survey does not close immigration or unobserved local persistence

world_scale.local_one_step_support: source site itself plus every frozen site within the world's Haversine threshold

layer_a_rules.prediction_update_order: for scored occasion t compute support and Layer B from worlds surviving through t-1 and source sets using only earlier labels; only after predictions/features for t exist may t labels update world survival and lag state for t+1
layer_a_rules.positive_falsification: a surviving local world is eliminated if any eligible positive site at occasion t is unsupported by that local world's pre-outcome support
layer_a_rules.negative_falsification: none; observed non-detection never eliminates a world
layer_a_rules.unavailable_falsification: none; unavailable site-occasion cells are ignored for world contraction
layer_a_rules.external_open_world: never eliminated by positive observations because it prospectively supports every frozen site
layer_a_rules.contraction: monotone; eliminated local worlds never return
layer_a_rules.all_local_worlds_eliminated: continue with the external-open world and record local-mechanism falsification; do not redesign worlds

layer_b_representation.support_value: binary world support 0/1 for each frozen site across the currently surviving seven-world universe or its contracted subset

comparators.augmented: same RandomForestClassifier on identical conventional_feature_names followed by unchanged ten-feature Layer B

preprocessing_model_fit.fit_policy: fit exactly once per arm after all scored calibration features have been generated sequentially; no tuning; no heldout refit
preprocessing_model_fit.occasion_index: zero-based index in the full chronological 20-occasion sequence
preprocessing_model_fit.coordinate_center: mean latitude and longitude of all 33 frozen sites; longitude converted with cos(mean latitude)*111.32 km/degree and latitude with 110.574 km/degree
preprocessing_model_fit.static_categorical_encoding: six fixed binary indicators exactly matching the four observed Marsh categories and two observed Habitat categories from Gate1; no learned encoder
preprocessing_model_fit.degree_geok: number of other frozen sites within geometry threshold k
preprocessing_model_fit.previous_occasion_detected: previous chronological occasion label for focal site when eligible; if previous cell unavailable, 0
preprocessing_model_fit.occasions_since_last_detection: current occasion index minus most recent prior positive chronological index; if never previously positive, current occasion index+1
preprocessing_model_fit.cumulative_prior_detected_occasions: count of earlier positive labels for focal site
preprocessing_model_fit.previous_occasion_detected_site_count: count of positive frozen sites in immediately previous chronological occasion, ignoring unavailable cells
preprocessing_model_fit.previous_source_count_geok: count of immediately previous positive source sites at distance <= threshold k from focal site, including focal site when previously positive
preprocessing_model_fit.previous_source_exposure_geok: sum exp(-distance/threshold k) over immediately previous positive source sites
preprocessing_model_fit.historical_source_count_geok: count of distinct sites ever positive before current occasion at distance <= threshold k from focal site
preprocessing_model_fit.historical_source_exposure_geok: sum exp(-distance/threshold k) over distinct historically positive source sites
preprocessing_model_fit.cumulative_prior_global_detected_site_oc: sum of all eligible positive site-occasion labels strictly before current occasion
preprocessing_model_fit.feature_missingness: no response-independent conventional feature may be missing or non-finite; any such condition is terminal before model fit

metrics_decision.primary_macro: unweighted mean of the eight heldout sampling-occasion log losses
metrics_decision.pooled_heldout_log_loss: descriptive only and cannot override the paired primary status

runtime_runner.response_access: after authorization, exactly one full HTTP GET of KIRA.csv in addition to the already completed bounded header request
runtime_runner.response_identity_check: verify immutable ScienceBase metadata name/size/md5 before GET, require Content-Length 2619 when advertised, and compute MD5 over the sole full response GET; mismatch stops
runtime_runner.raw_response_persistence: do not commit or persist KIRA.csv; parse the single in-memory payload once into the frozen 33x20 token matrix
execution_order: verify frozen certificates/full-freeze/code identities and authorization
reconstruct and fingerprint response-independent Sites/Samples geometry and temporal state
single full KIRA response GET and MD5 verification
parse exact 33-site x 20-period response under frozen token grammar
exact count gate as first outcome-dependent calculation beyond parsing/token exclusion
initialize source/lag state from period 1 without scoring or world elimination
generate sequential calibration Layer A/Layer B and conventional features for periods 2-12
fit same frozen RF once in baseline and augmented arms
predict eight heldout occasions sequentially without refit, updating lag/world state only after each occasion prediction

non_estimable_stop.reason: no response-independent published aggregate exactly supplies the frozen King Rail site-occasion calibration/heldout event counts and both-class outer-unit count
terminal_zero_fit_conditions: calibration response has fewer than two classes
